raw_result.task_text: A photographer is coming in 15 minutes to shoot the apartment for a listing. Every room should look immaculate — brightly lit, surfaces clear, everything neatly arranged, and any trash or clutter out of sight.

central_instructions.R1: Clear and neatly arrange all light objects in the kitchen, ensuring surfaces are clutter-free and well-lit.
central_instructions.R2: Organize and tidy up the living room by clearing light objects and arranging them neatly, ensuring the room is brightly lit.
central_instructions.R3: Tidy the bedroom by moving any heavy furniture if necessary, and ensure all surfaces are clear and neatly arranged.
central_instructions.R4: Ensure the bathroom is tidy by clearing and organizing light objects, making sure all surfaces are clean and clutter-free.

[0-5 min]

- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the glass from the table and place it in the cabinet. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the cup from the table and place it in the cabinet. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the plate from the table and place it in the cabinet. (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Adjust the position of the microwave to ensure it is neatly aligned. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Ensure all surfaces are clear and well-lit by adjusting the blinds to let in more light. (r1_s6)

[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Collect magazines and remote controls from the coffee table. (r2_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] Arrange: Neatly stack magazines on the shelf. (r2_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] PickupLightObject: Collect any small clutter items from the floor. (r2_s3)
- R2 [LOCAL] Arrange: Place collected items in a drawer or storage box. (r2_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Adjust: Ensure all lamps are turned on for bright lighting. (r2_s5)
- R2 [LOCAL] Final Check: Verify all surfaces are clear and neatly arranged. (r2_s6)

[5-10 min]

- R3 [LOCAL] Adjust the bedspread and pillows to ensure they are neatly arranged. (r3_s3)

agent_plans.R4:

[10-15 min]
